name: Acid_Arrow
display_fullname: Defender Buff Trick Arrow Acid Arrow
display_help: This arrow explodes in a small shower of acid on impact. This acid eats through armor, causing damage over time. It reduces the target's Defense as well as their Damage Resistance. Acid Arrow places the Acid Burn effect on targets; Acid Burned targets are more vulnerable to debilitating effects and will suffer increased Tohit debuff from Flash Arrow, increased Regeneration debuffs from Poison Gas Arrow and EMP Arrow, increased Slows from Entangling Arrow, Glue Arrow, Ice Arrow, and Oil Slick Arrow, and increased Endurance Drain from EMP Arrow. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Slow
display_short_help: Ranged AoE Minor DoT(Toxic), Foe -Res(All), -DEF, Special
